title: What Is Imagery? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: identify sensory language and descriptive details
analyze how imagery shapes mood, tone, and meaning
support interpretations of imagery with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces imagery as a literary device that uses sensory and descriptive language to create vivid mental experiences for readers. Supports close reading, analysis of mood and tone, author's craft, and evidence-based interpretation across high school English courses.
